title: Thai-Style Flax Omelette
description: A simple and nutritious breakfast dish filled with the flavors of Thailand. Flaxseeds add omega-3 rich goodness to this egg-based omelette.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs for a fluffy omelette

ingredients.name: flax
ingredients.notes: Ground flaxseed for a nutty flavor and omega-3 boost

ingredients.name: thai
ingredients.notes: Thai red curry paste for a spicy kick

ingredients.name: heart
ingredients.notes: Diced heart of palm for added texture

instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork.
Add the ground flaxseed and whisk until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the Thai red curry paste.
Pour in the egg mixture and let it cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges start to set.
Add the diced heart of palm and fold the omelette in half.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes until the cheese is melted and the omelette is cooked through.
Slide the omelette onto a plate and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs or chilies for added flavor.
